claims.text: The loan amount is the home price minus the down payment, exact to the cent.
The principal-and-interest payment is the standard fixed-rate payment, exact to the cent.
Monthly tax and insurance are the yearly amounts you typed divided by 12 and rounded half up to the cent. HOA and mortgage insurance are used as typed.
The total monthly payment is the sum of the five monthly parts, exact to the cent.
Total interest is the sum of each month's interest over the whole loan, rounded half up to the cent each month.
The first payment's interest and principal add up to the principal-and-interest payment.
A rate of 0, a one-year loan and a 100-year loan all work out exactly.
Messy typing never gives a wrong number, NaN or a crash.
A bad entry gets a calm message in plain words that names the field.
